title: Light Carbon LCR018-D First Ride!

takeaways.text: On the first ride the seatpost and saddle slipped (he blames too little carbon paste and the hard-to-torque rail bolts).
A creak under out-of-saddle effort came from the down-tube storage bag's zip pull hitting the inside of the tube.

After 100 km one bolt of the storage-cover clip had fallen into the frame and the other was loose; with threadlock and thicker rubber on the cover it went quiet, but he remains wary of down-tube storage rattles.
Once sorted he finds it comfortable and stiff enough to get up to speed quickly.

disclosure: Owner video; no sponsorship is stated.
summary: First rides on the owner's LCR018-D, tracing slipping parts and noises to their causes.
